{{Quote|I don't know what's worse. That you were gonna do this or that you hired a pilot other than me to do it with.|Trace Martez, to her sister Rafa|<ref name="Deal No Deal" />}}
A '''pilot''' was active on [[Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars]].<ref name="Deal No Deal" /> In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Date note">The episode "[[Deal No Deal]]" takes place in between the [[Trial of Ahsoka Tano]] and the [[Siege of Mandalore]]. The trial is dated to [[19 BBY]] by ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'', and the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Clone Wars'']] episode "[[Old Friends Not Forgotten]]" shows that the Siege of [[Mandalore]] takes place concurrently to the [[Battle of Coruscant]], which ''Galactic Atlas'' also dates to that [[Standard year|year]]. Therefore, the events of "Deal No Deal," including [[Rafa Martez|Rafa's]] mentioning of hiring the pilot, must also take place in 19 BBY.</ref> he agreed to do a job [[Spicerunner|running]] [[Sansanna spice|spice]] with the small-time criminal [[Rafa Martez]] and supplied both a [[starship]] and crew. He later backed out of the job, however, forcing Martez to turn to her younger sister [[Trace Martez|Trace]] and her untested ship, the ''[[Silver Angel]]''.<ref name="Deal No Deal" />
